subject: a marble-textured planet beneath ring shadows
art_direction: 粉灰星球的表面如大理石纹，巨大的环影落在下方形成深蓝弧带。
visible_description: 粉灰星球的表面如大理石纹，巨大的环影落在下方形成深蓝弧带。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Render a pale rose-gray planet as subtly veined mineral, positioned toward the lower left. A broad ring shadow sweeps across its surface in one deep-blue arc, revealing curvature through soft transitions. Keep the marble detail refined and sparse, with restrained light along the lower edge. Empty desaturated space above makes the geometry feel monumental and composed. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
